title: Constrain supervisor-executed documented test commands to a non-mutating program profile (G3 LOW-1 follow-up to M0-T148)
objective: M0-T148 made documented_test_commands an ACTIVE supervisor-side execution surface (evidence.py run_command). validate_documented_test_commands admits any single clean metacharacter-free segment, including mutating commands like 'git push origin b' or 'rm -rf tools'; today only the orchestrator-authored task packet prevents execution of such commands at review time - convention, not guard. Add an enforced non-mutating program profile for supervisor-executed documented commands (allowlist of test runners, or destructive-program + read-only-git classification reuse from the policy engine) with positive/negative tests, and correct the M0-T148 producer-report 'never git' wording to describe the enforced guard. Evidence: project-control/reports/M0-T148-G3-code-review.md LOW-1; qualifying evidence AD-093 = demonstrated security risk (defense-in-depth gap identified at G3 review of accepted commit 53d642a1).
business_reason: Defense-in-depth: the review-time execution channel must not rely solely on control-plane authorship to exclude mutating commands.
documented_test_commands: python -m ruff check tools/agent_supervisor/evidence.py tools/agent_supervisor/policy.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_reviewer.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_policy.py
